title: Docmost
descript: Docmost is a self-hosted team wiki and documentation platform: spaces, nested pages, real-time co-editing, comments, page permissions, attachments, full-text search, version history and public sharing. This package runs the official Docker Hub image with its own PostgreSQL database and Redis cache as non-root containers; pages, attachments and accounts stay in the application data folder.
release_note: Rectified per review comments (C3 C4 C5 C7 C9 C10 F1 F5 T1): added a complete privacy policy covering pages, attachments, accounts, sessions and WebSocket collaboration; rewrote the descriptions and the 23-language file; completed README, NOTICE and the repository layout; hardened the three-container stack (pinned images, per-service healthchecks, longer first-start grace, telemetry disabled, Redis AOF); T1 addressed with the current upstream 0.90.0 image and pinned PostgreSQL 16.16 / Redis 8.10.3 patch releases.
important: Requires DockerEngine. Complete the first-run wizard to create the workspace and administrator account. Accounts, pages, comments, attachments and permissions are stored under DockerAppData/docmostdocker/ and survive restarts and updates. No mail server is configured by default: invitation and reset links go to the container log; configure SMTP for delivery. The UI is plain HTTP on the LAN - use a TLS reverse proxy before internet exposure. Deleting the data folder on uninstall erases everything.

verified.telemetry: disabled in the package via DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true

zh-cn.descript: Docmost 是自建的团队 Wiki 与文档协作平台：空间、嵌套页面、多人实时协同编辑、评论、页面权限、附件、全文检索、版本历史与公开分享。所有内容保存在 NAS 的应用数据目录，数据库与缓存仅容器内部访问，容器以非 root 运行。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine。首次打开按向导创建工作区与管理员账号；账号、页面、评论、附件与权限保存在 DockerAppData/docmostdocker/，重启和升级不丢失。默认未配置邮件服务，邀请/重置链接写入容器日志，正式使用请配置 SMTP。界面为 HTTP，公网访问前请加 TLS 反向代理。卸载时删除数据目录会永久清除全部内容。
zh-cn.release_note: 按上轮审核意见整改（C3/C4/C5/C7/C9/C10/F1/F5/T1）：补全隐私政策，覆盖页面、附件、账号、会话与 WebSocket 协同；重写描述与 23 语文件；补全 README、NOTICE 与仓库目录结构；加固三容器栈（固定镜像、逐服务健康检查、延长首次启动宽限、关闭遥测、Redis 开启 AOF）；T1 采用当前上游 0.90.0 并固定 PostgreSQL 16.16 / Redis 8.10.3 补丁版本。

zh-hk.descript: Docmost 是自建的團隊 Wiki 與文件協作平台：空間、巢狀頁面、多人即時協同編輯、留言、頁面權限、附件、全文檢索、版本歷史與公開分享。所有內容保存在 NAS 的應用資料目錄，資料庫與快取僅容器內部存取，容器以非 root 執行。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine。首次開啟依精靈建立工作區與管理員帳號；帳號、頁面、留言、附件與權限保存在 DockerAppData/docmostdocker/，重新啟動和升級不會遺失。預設未設定郵件服務，邀請/重設連結會寫入容器日誌，正式使用請設定 SMTP。介面為 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請加 TLS 反向代理。解除安裝時刪除資料目錄會永久清除全部內容。
zh-hk.release_note: 依上輪審核意見整改（C3/C4/C5/C7/C9/C10/F1/F5/T1）：補齊隱私政策，涵蓋頁面、附件、帳號、工作階段與 WebSocket 協同；重寫描述與 23 語檔案；補齊 README、NOTICE 與倉庫目錄結構；加固三容器棧（固定映像、逐服務健康檢查、延長首次啟動寬限、關閉遙測、Redis 啟用 AOF）；T1 採用目前上游 0.90.0 並固定 PostgreSQL 16.16 / Redis 8.10.3 修補版本。

data_notes: Three host paths, all below `/Volume1/DockerAppData/docmostdocker/`: `storage/` -> `/app/data/storage` keeps uploaded attachments, avatars, page covers/icons and the generated `.app_secret`; `db/` -> `/var/lib/postgresql/data` keeps the PostgreSQL cluster (PGDATA is `db/pgdata`), which is the system of record for pages, comments, accounts, sessions and permissions; `redis/` -> `/data` keeps the Redis AOF (cache, queues, rate limits and WebSocket pub/sub).
design_notes: **Three services, one published port.** Only the Docmost app publishes 8087 -> 3000; PostgreSQL and Redis are on the private Compose network and are never reachable from the LAN.
**Non-root everywhere.** Every service pins `user: "1000:1000"`; there is no privileged mode, host network, Docker socket or added capability.
**APP_SECRET is generated, never shipped.** The wrapper writes a 96-hex-character secret to `/app/data/storage/.app_secret` (mode 0600) on first start and reuses it across restarts and upgrades.
**Cache is disposable, but persistent.** Redis runs with `--appendonly yes` so a restart does not lose the queue/pub-sub state; the database remains the source of truth.
**Telemetry off.** `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true` is set explicitly; the upstream telemetry client therefore never posts to `tel.docmost.com`.
limitations: - The UI is plain HTTP on the LAN; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- The default `MAIL_DRIVER=log` writes invitation and password-reset links to the container log. Configure SMTP/Postmark if you need real mail delivery.

- `APP_URL` is set to `http://localhost:8087` because the NAS LAN address is not known at install time. If you use e-mail invitations or SSO, change it to `http://<NAS-IP>:8087` in the Compose file and recreate the container.

- Advanced storage (S3/Azure), search (Typesense), AI providers and Gotenberg PDF export are supported by upstream but are not configured by this package; enabling them sends data to the endpoint you choose.

- T1: Docmost 0.90.0 is the current upstream release and the image tag is pinned; PostgreSQL 16.16 and Redis 8.10.3 are pinned to current patch releases. CVEs in Docmost's bundled Node dependencies require an upstream rebuild.
